rules.name: PowerShell Suspicious Execution
rules.description: Detect encoded PowerShell, -bypass, hidden window, and download cradle patterns
rules.query: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4688 | where NewProcessName contains "powershell" or CommandLine contains "execution" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, Account, NewProcessName | where count_ > 5 // AZ-EXECUTION-137
